Scatter

Source: R/lax_slicing.R
lax_scatter.Rd

Ports of jax.lax.scatter (updates replace values), scatter_add, scatter_sub, scatter_mul, scatter_min, scatter_max and scatter_apply (XLA Scatter). Most code should use at_set(), at_add() and friends instead. With repeated indices, lax_scatter applies the updates in an unspecified order. lax_scatter_apply is not compatible with automatic differentiation.

Usage

lax_scatter(
  operand,
  scatter_indices,
  updates,
  dimension_numbers,
  indices_are_sorted = FALSE,
  unique_indices = FALSE,
  mode = NULL
)

lax_scatter_add(
  operand,
  scatter_indices,
  updates,
  dimension_numbers,
  indices_are_sorted = FALSE,
  unique_indices = FALSE,
  mode = NULL
)

lax_scatter_sub(
  operand,
  scatter_indices,
  updates,
  dimension_numbers,
  indices_are_sorted = FALSE,
  unique_indices = FALSE,
  mode = NULL
)

lax_scatter_mul(
  operand,
  scatter_indices,
  updates,
  dimension_numbers,
  indices_are_sorted = FALSE,
  unique_indices = FALSE,
  mode = NULL
)

lax_scatter_min(
  operand,
  scatter_indices,
  updates,
  dimension_numbers,
  indices_are_sorted = FALSE,
  unique_indices = FALSE,
  mode = NULL
)

lax_scatter_max(
  operand,
  scatter_indices,
  updates,
  dimension_numbers,
  indices_are_sorted = FALSE,
  unique_indices = FALSE,
  mode = NULL
)

lax_scatter_apply(
  operand,
  scatter_indices,
  func,
  dimension_numbers,
  update_shape = integer(0),
  indices_are_sorted = FALSE,
  unique_indices = FALSE,
  mode = NULL
)

Arguments

operand

Array to which the scatter is applied.

scatter_indices

Integer array of indices; its last dimension is the index vector dimension.

updates

Updates scattered onto operand.

dimension_numbers

A lax_ScatterDimensionNumbers() value.

indices_are_sorted

Whether the indices are known to be sorted.

unique_indices

Whether the updated elements are guaranteed not to overlap.

mode

Out of bounds mode: "clip" clamps indices, "fill" or "drop" (the default, also for NULL) and "promise_in_bounds" drop out of bounds updates. See lax_GatherScatterMode.

func

Unary function of a scalar applied at each index; repeated indices apply it several times.

update_shape

Shape of the updates at the given indices.

Value

The updated array.
